name: IIM Sirmaur

about.text: Indian Institute of Management Sirmaur (IIM Sirmaur) is a prominent and leading institution funded by the Government of India. The institute was established in 2015 at Rampur Ghat Road, Paonta Sahib, District Sirmaur, Himachal Pradesh. It is one of the youngest siblings of the IIM family in India.

IIM Sirmaur was established with the main objective of being a globally reputed institution in the management field. The IIM gives globally renowned practical exposure to education to students for their better future prospects. The institute has always been top-ranked, and the quality of education has no match. Known for its rigorous curriculum, industry collaborations, and emphasis on holistic development, social responsibility, and global excellence.

about.text: The Institute offers MBA, Executive Programs, PG Diploma Programs, and Ph.D. Programs. IIM Sirmaur is under the third generation of IIMs, which ranks 57th in the National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) ‘management’ category, and it is chosen by the Ministry of Education as a top nodal center of AICTE QIP (Quality Improvement Programs) for serving faculty.

aboutBoxes.title: Online Degree Acceptance
aboutBoxes.content: Online degrees earned from a government-approved university, just like a regular degree, are accepted by the top recruiters worldwide including government & private sectors.

aboutBoxes.title: Value of Online Degree
aboutBoxes.content: An online degree from a government-approved university holds similar recognition in the industry as that of a regular degree. Thus, it is equally valuable when considered for a job or higher education.

aboutBoxes.title: Quality of Education
aboutBoxes.content: The quality of education offered in online programs is of the same standard as offered in an on-campus program. Be it curriculum, faculty members, evaluation methods, practical sessions, online & on-campus programs follow similar standards of quality.

emi.text: The IIM Sirmaur Online offers loan facilities to its students enrolled in both online and regular programs with the objective of offering financial aid to students who are unable to pursue their higher studies due to financial hindrances. The institute also offers various scholarships for financial assistance to the students, interested candidates can apply for the scholarship according to their eligibility criteria, which can be checked on the official website of IIM Sirmaur. A few scholarships offered at the institute are:
Post Matric Scholarships Scheme for Minorities
Scholarships for Top Class Education for students with disabilities.
Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme For RPF/RPSF
Note : There is no fee for a Ph.D. student, meanwhile they will receive 30,000 INR per month for 5 years to cover the living expenses of the student.

admission.text: The selection process will be governed by statutes, ordinances, rules, regulations, policies, guidelines and procedures of the respective institutions under the collaboration.
Step 1: Applicants will be requested to submit an online application form and upload the required documentation.
Step 2: The required documents include and may not be limited to: (1) enrolment application; (ii) CV; (iii) Photo with white background; and (iv) Transcript with marks.
Step 3: Additional documents may include, but are not limited to, Experience Certificates (if any), other Professional Body Certificates etc.,
Step 4: Once the documents have been submitted and approved, the student needs to complete the payment for the program.
Step 5: Once the student's status has been validated with documents and payments, the student will receive a written and PI call letter.
Step 6: Upon satisfactorily clearing the basic criteria set by both the Institution’s, the Student will be issued with an Acceptance Letter.
